description: This is an Android activity class (ContentInfoActivity) written in Kotlin, which displays detailed content information such as program title, channel info, metadata, description, system date/time, and includes interactive buttons for actions like play, schedule, record, and more. It handles UI setup, focus navigation with D-PAD, fetching media URLs from API, and launching a media player activity.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity displaying detailed content info with metadata, background, action buttons, and system date/time. Handles fetching media URL, button interactions, and focus navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures UI elements, populates content data, and sets up focusable action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets current system date and time in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Loads content metadata and description from intent extras or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, assigns icons, and sets focus and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates UI focus effects on action buttons.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Executes action associated with a button click, including animations and specific functionality.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles D-PAD navigation and selection via hardware keys.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Fetches media URL via API and launches media player activity.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses API response to extract media URL, supports JSON or plain URL.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an intent with content metadata to launch this activity.
